lines.en: label halloweenfour4:
scene hallomakomiku1
song change.
: Hello, Makoto and Miku. The time has come for me to ignore everyone else and talk to you for several minutes before ultimately leaving in order to even out all of the characters’ screen time.
: You in some kinda game or somethin’ now?
: Sometimes, it feels that way. That explanation of things is getting canned and tiresome though and it’s about time I start growing up and looking at the world as a world. Am I right?
: I ain’t got any clue what you’re talkin’ about, but probably. I like leavin’ all the difficult decisions and stuff to adults.
: I’m not sure if I’d even count Sensei as an adult at this point in time.
: I would. Otherwise, you probably wouldn’t want to have sex with me.
scene hallomakomiku2
laughtrack.
: Was that really necessary?
: He ain’t wrong. If ya ask me, a lotta Sensei’s charm is the fact that he can get us into R-rated movies and teach us how to do our taxes and stuff.
: Ami would probably be better off at that last part than me, but I feel as if I’m only saying that because memories from an alternate universe are subtly popping into my head right now.
: Well, try to keep yourself grounded for a moment longer as I have an important matter that needs to be discussed right now.
scene hallomakomiku3
: Oh, come on! Can’t ya hold off until the party’s over at least? There ain’t no need to get all depressing right now when the night’s only just begun!
: I agree with Miku. I’ve got enough going on internally right now to last the rest of the year. Or whatever’s left of it, at least. Which could be anywhere from thirty seconds to a million years.
scene hallomakomiku4
: Now, I ain’t no math whiz, but I’m pretty sure you’re wrong about that one, Sensei.
: I suppose considering that both of you are going to be dodgy and reluctant to engage on this matter, I’ll keep what I have to say short and sweet.
: I do not know what you did, or what you thought you were doing, but there are some things that I will not allow to slip by me even in a never-ending school year.
scene hallomakomiku5
: A never-ending what now? The heck is going on with both of you?
: I’m disappointed in you, Sensei. I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why.
: Do you have anything to say for yourself?
: Only that I knew this was coming and it doesn’t make it any less demoralizing to hear you say that.
: Good. You should be demoralized. In fact, you should be much more than that. Because if it weren’t for my mother and me, Miku would likely be foaming from the mouth in her bed right now.
: The heck is gonna happen to my mouth?
: Be quiet, Miku. I’ve already scolded you. It’s Sensei’s turn now.
scene hallomakomiku6
: I already told ya, Makoto. Sensei didn’t have anythin’ to do with what happened. That whole thing was on me and nobody else.
: Is that true, Sensei? Did you really have absolutely no knowledge of this whatsoever? Or would you like to use this opportunity to try honesty for the first-
: I knew.
: I knew and I didn’t do anything about it because I was scared.
: And I’m sorry.
: It won’t happen again.
scene hallomakomiku7
: Hah...

: Forgive what I can only imagine will be a rather offensive question, but...are you abusing drugs as well? Because there is no circumstance in which I can imagine you genuinely saying what you just said.
: I’m not. You’ve saved my ass eight million times and you’re still courteous enough to give me the benefit of the doubt when I haven’t deserved it even once.
: It’s no wonder I love you.
scene hallomakomiku8
: Jeez! Get a friggin’ room if yer gonna be sayin’ stuff like that!
: That...you...why...
scene hallomakomiku9
: Stop it! You’re not supposed to say things like that in public! Let alone while I’m mad at you!
: You ain’t ever told me you love me. What’s the deal with that?
: That’s easy. I don’t love you.
scene hallomakomiku10
: What the heck?! At least fake it, ya jerk!
: R...Regardless of how you feel about me...don’t...don’t let me down like that again. Okay?
: Miku’s not only my friend, she’s family. And if anything ever happened to her, I...have no idea what I’d do.
: I know. I’ve known that from the start and I’m sorry you have to always put up with a sack of shit like me.
scene hallomakomiku11
: Well, now you’re just startin’ to sound like Io.
: Miku’s right. You sound rather self-deprecating and miserable by even your standards, Sensei. Has this really gotten to you this badly?

: I don’t think that’s what’s going on. Like, sure, it probably doesn’t help. But ever since I woke up, I’ve felt like there are strings attached to my shoulders and waist that are just dragging me around.
: My mouth is dry. My head hurts. Everything seems foggy. And scenes keep cutting out in the middle of-
scene hallomakomiku12
: ...the revolution!
: The what now?
scene hallomakomiku13
: The revolution, damn it! Us girls have been oppressed for far too long and the time has come for us to rise up and say to the fashion industry, “We deserve pockets too!”
: Real pockets! Ones we can fit a full phone in instead of just 33%% of one!

: I’m surprised you’re advocating for this at all when you’ve already found a way to defy the laws of fashion by storing an entire room’s worth of stuff in that band you keep wrapped around your thigh.
: My ingenuity means nothing in the face of a much greater evil! Tell ‘em, Kirin!
: It’s all a conspiracy. All of the major brands are in the pockets of handbag companies and adding full-sized pockets to their pants would cause a rift in the market that could crash the economy.
: And it is we who have to suffer because of this corporate greed! It is we who must always lose our phones or tie things around our legs so the rich can get richer!
: But I like handbags. A lot of them are really cute. I don’t think having pockets is enough to make me, like...not want to buy one.
: You guys talk about some real boring shit, you know.
: But yeah, I’m down for some deeper pockets. The ones on these shorts are so tight I’m surprised they didn’t come with our teacher’s fingers stuffed inside ‘em.
scene hallomakomiku14
: Hot.
: Super hot.
: Yumi, come on.
: What? I’m just sayin’ I support whatever the fuck’s bein’ sold to me right now. And as the only person here with an entrepreneurial record, I’m pretty sure that’s a fair thing for me to do.
: Yeah, but you’re not the only person here with an “entrepreneurial record” since Kirin’s been selling her nudes online since the third grade.
: Hey, good one.
scene hallomakomiku15
: What do you mean, “good one?” That’s the part where you’re supposed to say something mean about me. Then we go back and forth throwing shade at each other until one of us walks away.
: Meh. I don’t feel like it tonight.
: That was funny and I’m not about to start shit with you just because you made some joke about me being a slut while my underwear’s pulled up higher than my shorts.
: So yeah! Good one. And also, you look really hot in that pirate costume. Did you make it yourself?
scene hallomakomiku16
: Uh...th...thank you? And...Uta and I made them together.
: Cool. Invite me next time.
: Sorry, are we friends now? How did that happen?
scene hallomakomiku17
: I don’t know if we’re friends. I just don’t really hate you or anything. I totally get it if you hate me, though. I can be a real bitch sometimes.
: What on earth is happening right now?
: Kirin’s reached her “good girl” arc and we’re all supposed to encourage her so that, one day, she’ll wear costumes with the underwear pulled a little bit lower.
: Noriko’s right. The time has finally come for me to start growing up.
: Well...congrats and all, but exactly how many dudes did you have to fuck before you got to that point?
scene hallomakomiku18
: Just one. But he fucks me so good it makes me want to change my ways.
: Have you, like...actually done it? Because I can’t tell if you’re just screwing with me right now.
: Oh yeah. Tons of times. Have you?
: Well...
: Jesus fucking Christ, do the three of you have any interest in literally anything that doesn’t involve a dick?
scene hallomakomiku19
: Hey! I’ve been good tonight! I just wanted to talk about pants and female oppression!
: Then put a leash on fucking Annie Chokely here and get her to talk about something else! This kinda shit makes some people uncomfortable, you know.
: Fine, fine. Let’s all do what the birthday girl wants and talk about her special day instead. Ooh! We can even sing her a song and get her a cake.
scene hallomakomiku20
: Aight, never mind. Go back to talkin’ about gettin’ raw dogged or whatever. Ain’t nobody singin’ to me.
: Oh, right. It is your birthday, isn’t it? How did I forget?
: How’d you even know? Don’t remember ever tellin’ you. Or anybody for that matter.
: We keep an extensive profile of everyone in the class so we can be fully prepared for our end-of-the-year orgy party.
: That is not why we keep extensive profiles on everyone. But I will admit that I can see it helping with such a thing should my self-esteem ever be reduced to the point in which I would do that.
: I think I’ll speak on Yumi’s behalf right now and say thanks for the offer to sing, but...that’s not really her thing.
: Is anything her thing? Because it seems like Halloween isn’t either if she’s never even going to dress up for it.
: So what? Noriko’s not dressed up either.
scene hallomakomiku21
: Hah...
: Don’t worry, Noriko. I’m sure somebody is bound to recognize your costume tonight.
: Oh, shit. Are you actually dressed up as someone? It just looked like a normal uniform to me.
: She’s that chick from Your Name, ain’t she? Mitsuha or whatever. You can tell from the ribbon.
scene hallomakomiku22
: Yes! That’s exactly it! Thank God that someone finally noticed! I was about to disown all of you!
: Well, that was the last person I would have guessed to pick up on it.
: Yeah, how the hell did you know that? That’s a romance movie, isn’t it?
: I watched it with Chinami while you were at work a while back. It was actually pretty good.
: Plus, it ain’t like I’m against that kind of shit. You know I read manga.
scene hallomakomiku23
: Yeah, but you read all of that action and sports stuff they aim at little boys.
: Doesn’t mean I don’t, like...what’s the phrase again?...Oh, yeah. Doesn’t mean I don’t broaden my horizons every once in a while, though.
: Do you want to watch it together sometime? I love that movie. In fact, I love pretty much everything Shinkai has-
scene hallomakomiku24
: Abso-fucking-lutely not. Never invite me to do anything again. You’re too...pink. It hurts my eyes.
: Oh...Oh, okay.
: There’s the Yumi I know.
: You are very pink sometimes, Noriko. She isn’t wrong.
scene hallomakomiku25
: You clearly haven’t spent enough time with my sister if you think I’m the one who’s too pink.
: Sister? Niki? Are we talking about Niki now?
: You won’t let me hang out with your sister because you know I’ll try to finger her. Or be fingered by her. Or pretty much any other sexual thing because God damn I want her to fuck me.

: As the president of Kumon-mi’s official Niki fan-club and admin of seven different Facebook pages revolving around her, I’d like to say now that idols can’t ever have sex and if they do, they immediately die.
: But also that it would be with me if such a thing ever happened and definitely not you since you probably don’t know the first thing about her, you fucking wannabe whore.
scene hallomakomiku26
: Okay, that one was uncalled for.
: Don’t sexualize the queen, bitch. That’s sacred ground.
: Speaking of sacred ground, please excuse me while I reach under my skirt for my phone. Somebody’s calling me.
if yumicthree == True:
scene hallomakomiku28
: Hello?
: While Noriko’s on the phone, I have something to ask you really quick. Just keep your voice down since I don’t want Kirin to hear it and wind up inviting herself instead.
: Uhh...what?
: I was just wondering, on a scale of one to ten, how interested would you be in having a threesome with me and you-know-who?
: Are you fucking kidding me right now?
: Yeah, that’s kind of what I figured you’d say.
scene hallomakomiku29
: Wait, are you actually bein’ serious right now?
: I want to do something special for Sensei and-
: Then buy him a fucking cake or something! Don’t just offer up my v-card!
: No, listen. It wouldn’t be like that. It would just be, like...touching and stuff. You can even keep your clothes on if you want.
: This is a prank, right? You’ve gotta be fuckin’ with me right now.
: Yumi, don’t take this the wrong way, but if I’m going to have a threesome with literally any other girl, I want it to be you.
scene hallomakomiku30
: How the hell am I not supposed to take that the wrong way?!
: Shh! Keep it down!
scene hallomakomiku31
: How the hell am I not supposed to take that the wrong way?
: I just mean that I love you and I’m more comfortable with you than anybody else. Even if I’m bi, this is still really awkward for me. Like, what the hell do I do with another girl there?
: At least with you, I can make it fun. Plus, I’ve already seen you naked a million times.
: Chika, I ain’t doin’ this shit. I’m not into that kind of stuff. We might be best friends and all that, but we ain’t those kinda friends.
: You won’t even watch?
: Why the fuck would I?
: To be...supportive? And cheer me on while my boyfriend fucks me into oblivion?
: I’m just...
: Yeah, I’m just gonna forget you ever even asked this. Cool? Cool.
: You really won’t do it?
: Not a fucking chance.
: Sorry, can you speak up? I can’t really hear you.
scene hallomakomiku27
else:
scene hallomakomiku27
: Hello?
: If this is in regard to my call-to-action for female pants equality, I have a separate number for that. It’s-
